name: Magmaslug
lore: It moves a hand's width a day and melts the road behind it. Patient things kill the most travellers.
prompt: Fat fantasy slug with a body of dark cooled rock split by glowing orange magma seams, two short thick eyestalks with ember eyes held close to its body, a trail of molten drips beneath it, and small vents on its back puffing smoke.
